claims.text: The two PCE series do not use the same basis: one is in current (nominal) dollars and the other is in chained (inflation-adjusted) dollars, as indicated by the separate table headings.

The 2020 percent changes for PCE appear extreme relative to history (e.g., -3.9% chained, the largest decline since 1932's -9.0% per the 'Last period with smaller value' column), reflecting pandemic effects; this is inference about cause, not stated in the source.
